Cam (Sales): quick sync — Olive wants to start a POC next week. They're asking about model variants we can support (accuracy vs latency tradeoffs) and KMS for keys. Any blockers?
Maya (SE): @Cam we validated olive-13b-v2 and olive-13b-q4_kv on Dedicated. latency looks fine with batching=8, but q4_kv returns slightly different tokenization on their inputs (edge case with emojis).
Cam (Sales): Ugh, emojis in customer data woo. Is that a showstopper?
Maya (SE): Not a showstopper. We can run a quick tokenization normalization step in the client or serve the v2 FP16 variant for the POC. v2 costs ~1.8x but reduces mismatch.
Devon (CS): From CS: Olive needs SLA language for 99.5% uptime and a data-retention/KMS detail for their legal team. They asked if keys can be in their AWS KMS.
Rita (Security): We support external KMS via cross-account CMKs for Private/Dedicated. Need their KMS key ARN and a short security questionnaire. Also we should run an ingest-scan for PHI since they process health summaries.
Cam (Sales): I'll ping them for the ARN and have legal send the questionnaire. Any infra constraints on enabling cross-account KMS for the Dedicated pool?
Maya (SE): No infra constraint, but we need to update the deployment manifest:
```
model_variant: olive-13b-v2
kms: "aws:kms:arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/XXXXX"
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  target_latency_ms: 120
```
Also we should enable prefix KV caching for the conversational flow — reduces tokens by ~16%.
deploy-bot: deploy plan created for env:dedicated-olive-poc by @Maya. Status: pending-approval.
Rita (Security): Quick note: add transcript redaction in the pipeline and log redactors for PII. We'll add that to the questionnaire answers.
Devon (CS): For pricing, they asked about committed reserved capacity vs burst. Recommend a 3-month reserved for predictability — pricing estimate in the doc: https://redwood.internal/sales/quotes/olive-poc (internal link).
Cam (Sales): Can you add the estimate to the deal? I'll attach the KMS checklist once they share ARN.
Maya (SE): One more technical ask — their team wants gpt-style function calling; the olive-13b-v2 has partial support (structured outputs via templates). I'll drop a short sample to validate:
```
# sample prompt
Extract: {name, dob, medication[]}
```
If they need strict schema enforcement, we should recommend model chain with lightweight post-parse validation.
Rita (Security): Also ask for expected retention window and retention deletion cadence for the POC. If they want <30 days, ok. Longer needs legal sign-off.
Cam (Sales): Great. I'll collect ARN + retention + example prompts and push. @Maya can you prepare a 90-min technical walkthrough for next Tue?
Maya (SE): Yup — I'll schedule and include a short perf run (latency + token-cost baseline) and a sample of the emoji edge case.
Devon (CS): I'll prep the onboarding checklist and include an on-call contact for the first 48 hours.
Cam (Sales): Thanks team. I'll update the deal and cc @Rita when we get the ARN. :thumbsup:
